name: Otiluke's Resilient Sphere

targets.description: a Large or smaller creature or object

summary: Dex save or a Large or smaller creature or object is sealed inside an unbreakable globe of force.
text: A shimmering globe of force encloses a Large or smaller creature or object within range; an unwilling creature avoids it with a successful Dexterity saving throw. Nothing, whether physical objects, energy or other spell effects, can pass through the barrier in either direction, though a creature inside can breathe. The sphere is immune to all damage, and a creature or object inside can't be damaged by attacks or effects from outside, nor can a creature inside damage anything outside. The globe weighs nothing and is just big enough to hold its contents. A creature inside can take an action to push against the walls and roll the sphere at up to half its Speed, and others can pick it up and move it. A Disintegrate spell aimed at the globe destroys it without harming anything inside. Concentration, up to 1 minute.
